changes: First Modwerk port of Bryan T's VIBRATO: a pitch vibrato with its depth in cents, in sine, triangle, a two-note trill (SQR) or stepped random pitch (RND).
Runs on FX1 or FX2 of any audio track; SPD and DEP glide, so a fast twist or an LFO stays smooth.
Ported unchanged in sound; differs from octabam only where Modwerk loads it: always live on FX2, and both DSP cores share one random seed.
Experimental: not yet tested on the Modwerk base on a unit.
